description_en: Retrieves the URL and AccessToken for document preview
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-office-preview-url --project immdoctest --src-uri oss://test-bucket/mytest.doc --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetOfficePreviewURL

parameters.help_en:
The OSS path of the source data.

The OSS path follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
源数据的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: src_uri

parameters.help_en:
The suffix type of the source data. By default, the type of the source data is determined by the suffix of the OSS object.

You can set this parameter when the OSS object does not have a suffix.

The following file types are supported:

Spreadsheet files: et, xls, xlt, xlsx, xlsm, xltx, xltm, csv

Document files: doc, docx, txt, dot, wps, wpt, dotx, docm, dotm, rtf

Presentation files: ppt, pptx, pptm, ppsx, ppsm, pps, potx, potm, dpt, dps

PDF files: pdf
parameters.help_zh:
源数据的后缀类型。默认根据OSS对象的后缀名确定源数据的类型。

当OSS对象没有后缀名时，可以设置此参数。

目前支持的文件类型有：

表格文件：et、xls、xlt、xlsx、xlsm、xltx、xltm、csv

文字文件：doc、docx、txt、dot、wps、wpt、dotx、docm、dotm、rtf

演示文件：ppt、pptx、pptm、ppsx、ppsm、pps、potx、potm、dpt、dps

PDF格式文件：pdf
parameters.name: src_type

parameters.help_en:
The watermark type. Valid values:

0: no watermark
1: text watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。

0：无水印
1：文字水印
parameters.name: watermark_type

parameters.help_en:
The text of the text watermark.

This parameter takes effect only when WatermarkType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
文字水印的文字。

当WatermarkType设置为1时，才能设置此参数
parameters.name: watermark_value

parameters.help_en: The transparency of the text watermark. Default value: rgba(192, 192, 192, 0.6)
parameters.help_zh: 文字水印的透明度，默认值为rgba(192, 192, 192, 0.6)
parameters.name: watermark_fill_style

parameters.help_en: The font of the text watermark. Default value: bold 20px Serif
parameters.help_zh: 文字水印的字体，默认值为bold 20px Serif
parameters.name: watermark_font

parameters.help_en: The rotation angle of the text watermark. Default value: -0.7853982. Unit: radians
parameters.help_zh: 文字水印的旋转度，默认值为-0.7853982，单位为弧度
parameters.name: watermark_rotate

parameters.help_en: The horizontal spacing of the text watermark. Default value: 50. Unit: px
parameters.help_zh: 文字水印水平间距，默认值为50，单位为px
parameters.name: watermark_horizontal

parameters.help_en: The vertical spacing of the text watermark. Default value: 100. Unit: px
parameters.help_zh: 文字水印垂直间距，默认值为100，单位为px
parameters.name: watermark_vertical

AccessToken.description_en: The credential used to access the document preview server
AccessToken.description_zh: 访问文档预览服务器的凭证

AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the credential. The credential is valid for 30 minutes
AccessTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 凭证的过期时间，有效时间为30分钟

RefreshToken.description_en: The RefreshToken used to refresh the credential when it expires
RefreshToken.description_zh: 凭证过期时使用RefeshToken刷新凭证

RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the RefreshToken. The RefreshToken is valid for one day
RefreshTokenExpiredTime.description_zh: 刷新凭证的过期时间，有效时间为1天
